User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the AMpire Studio platform.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile photo.

creationTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the user was created.

lastSignInTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the user last signed in.

AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Represents the profile of an administrator user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the admin profile.

role.description: The role of the administrator (e.g., superAdmin, editor).

permissions.description: List of permissions granted to the administrator.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Uses path-based ownership for private user data.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

definition.description: Stores admin profiles. Includes a userId to reference the associated user. The existence of a document in this collection grants admin privileges.

params.name: adminProfileId
params.description: The unique identifier of the admin profile.

firestore.reasoning: This Firestore data structure is designed to support the AMpire Studio Dynamic Showcase application, focusing on user authentication, admin profiles, and future content management needs. It prioritizes security, scalability, and debuggability following the core design principles. Path-based ownership is used for user data, and a dedicated collection is used for admin profiles. The structure is designed to enable simple and robust security rules and facilitate listing operations (QAPs). This design avoids hierarchical authorization dependencies.
